limitations: Current-v7 preparation/export only; no activation, old-format migration, pending resolution or writer migration
Numeric guards do not promise arbitrary decimal rational fidelity; original lexical string is retained separately
Source equality checks are not a cross-storage lock and cannot detect unseen A-B-A changes
Same-origin raw copy is not an independent private browser backup
No real disk exhaustion, power loss or actual two-tab QA for this reader
Native daily/weekly external triggers still unobserved; manual starts are recorded separately
Scheduled restore reads VPS password; independent DPAPI recovery remains a separate phase-18 proof
Final receipts/docs postdate selected source checkpoint; private progress remains in browser
No retention/prune, bucket/IAM change or delivery acceleration; full billing unknown
